title: Director of Engineering & Continuous Improvement
text:
**Position Summary**

The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.

The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.

The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.

***This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.***

***Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.***

**Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to**

Process & Technical Engineering

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* **10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams**
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree
 **Physical Requirements**

**Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

degree.text: Bachelor's degree in engineering or related technical field
